definitions: Used to get the attention of someone who is daydreaming or not paying attention, often implying they are lost in thought or being oblivious.
A humorous way to call someone back to reality, especially if they are overly intellectualizing something or missing the obvious.
examples: Earth to Sheldon, are you going to help me with these groceries or just stare at your phone?
He was explaining a complex theory, and I had to say, 'Earth to Sheldon, we just need to know if it works.'
She was completely zoned out during the meeting; I almost said, 'Earth to Sheldon!'
